name: Loi n° 78-17 du 6 janvier 1978 relative à l'informatique, aux fichiers et aux libertés (modifiée)
description: Pioneering French data protection law (1978), substantially amended 2018-2019 to align with GDPR. Enforced by CNIL.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Légifrance (French government legal publisher) (legifrance.gouv.fr) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Légifrance (French government legal publisher) (legifrance.gouv.fr).
